penalties_applied.name: regulated_industry
penalties_applied.reason: GDPR/DPA compliance tooling sits squarely in regulated EU data-protection space; any output the service produces could be cited in a legal or supervisory context, raising liability and compliance overhead for the operator.

penalties_applied.name: requires_human_fulfillment
penalties_applied.reason: Building a privacy-safe analytics layer that correctly integrates with Salesforce Marketing Cloud, handles EU consent strings, and produces legally defensible aggregate reports requires significant per-client configuration and ongoing technical validation — not automatable by Claude alone.

penalties_applied.name: high_touch_support
penalties_applied.reason: Clients are legal/compliance-facing; any ambiguity in the output will trigger support escalations requiring human judgement.

rationale: The buyer is real — EU agencies on Salesforce Marketing Cloud with active legal pressure from French and Italian DPAs — and they genuinely have budget. However, the solution requires building a technically complex, legally defensible privacy-analytics middleware layer that integrates with a proprietary enterprise ESP (Salesforce Marketing Cloud has a closed, credentialed API ecosystem), which is well beyond what Claude + a simple page + Stripe can deliver without deep per-client integration work. Both the build and the ongoing delivery require human involvement per customer, and the regulated-industry penalty reflects the legal exposure of producing compliance-adjacent output for enterprise clients. This is a consulting engagement or a funded SaaS, not a solo AI-factory micro-service.
solution_plan: This cannot realistically be built and maintained as a solo non-technical operator micro-service. The core deliverable — a GDPR-compliant aggregate analytics layer sitting between Salesforce Marketing Cloud and a reporting dashboard — requires an accredited ESP integration, EU data-residency decisions, and per-client legal review of what 'aggregate' means under each client's DPA guidance. There is no version of this that Claude + a landing page + Stripe can ship and run hands-off. A realistic path would be a productised consultancy (human-delivered) or a VC-backed SaaS with compliance counsel — both out of scope for this factory.
notes: Fails operational_autonomy_min (scored 4, floor is 7) and buildability_with_ai_min (scored 4, floor is 6). Even without penalties the weighted total (5.6) barely clears validate threshold, and penalties push total to 2.1. Drop.
